access_evidence: PROBES.json reg_openfda_510k_001: HTTP 200 application/json 3,205 bytes for search=applicant:"MEDTRONIC"&limit=1. DATASETS/regulatory/openfda_device_510k/raw/ holds 8 pulls; 50/50 records in each firm pull match its applicant term (see CONNECTORS/regulatory/_verify_cache_integrity.py output).
historical_depth: FDA 510(k) decisions reported from 1976 onward; 1,588 MEDTRONIC matches, 1,036 GE matches, 994 PHILIPS matches, 34 DRAGER matches, 180 MINDRAY matches as of this run (meta.results.total). No historical supersession: one row per clearance.
licence_note: openFDA licence page: '...unless otherwise noted, the content, data, documentation, code, and related materials on openFDA is public domain and made available with a Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal dedication.' Caveat recorded on the same page: 'GMDN(R) is a registered trademark of The GMDN Agency... which is used under license from The GMDN Agency', with conditions on extracting GMDN Content. openFDA device endpoints do not carry GMDN fields, so this does not affect the openFDA records.
machine_interface: REST JSON: /device/510k.json with Lucene-style search, limit<=1000, skip
name: openFDA — device 510(k) clearances
notes: Records carry k_number, decision_date, product_code, applicant, device_name, advisory_committee. source_public_at is unknown (MISSING_PUBLICATION_DATE).
rate_policy: openFDA authentication page: 'With no API key: 240 requests per minute, per IP address. 1,000 requests per day, per IP address.' No X-RateLimit-* response headers are sent; observed: all keyless pulls returned 200 at ~1.2 req/s, no 429.
robots_summary: HTTP 404 with body 'Cannot GET /robots.txt' — no robots policy is served for the API host; access is governed by the published openFDA terms.
what_is_new: Adds the clearable event clock (decision_date) that GUDID lacks, and the official 510(k) number as a join key — the first precedent-shaped regulatory signal in MedRadar with a jurisdiction, a date and an identifier.
